mapper.update: UPDATE toolbox_job SET status = 'PROCESSING', progress = CASE WHEN progress < 5 THEN 5 ELSE progress END, message = 'Processing task', started_at = COALESCE(started_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND (status = 'PENDING' OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND updated_at < #{staleBefore}))

UPDATE toolbox_job SET status = 'SUCCESS', progress = 100, message = #{message}, result_object_key = #{resultObjectKey}, file_name = #{fileName}, content_type = #{contentType}, finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), expires_at = DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL 7 DAY) WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE toolbox_job SET status = 'FAILED', progress = 100, message = #{message}, finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE toolbox_job SET progress = #{progress}, message = #{message}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE toolbox_job SET status = 'PENDING', progress = 5, message = 'Retry queued', retry_count = retry_count + 1, result_object_key = NULL, file_name = NULL, content_type = NULL, finished_at = NULL, expires_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND organization_id = #{organizationId} AND status = 'FAILED'

UPDATE toolbox_job SET status = 'PENDING', progress = 5, message = 'Task recovered after worker restart', started_at = NULL, updated_at = #{staleBefore} WHERE status = 'PROCESSING' AND updated_at < #{staleBefore}

UPDATE toolbox_job SET status = 'EXPIRED', result_object_key = NULL, message = 'Result expired', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND status = 'SUCCESS' AND expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= #{now}
UPDATE toolbox_job SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM toolbox_job WHERE status = 'SUCCESS' AND expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= #{now} ORDER BY expires_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
